annotation.bound_parties_text: The non-binding resolution only calls on the Commission, Member States and others to act and imposes no obligations on any party.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Instructs its President to forward this resolution to the Council and the Commission.
annotation.dates_quote: European Parliament resolution of 20 May 2021 on shaping the digital future of Europe: removing barriers to the functioning of the digital single market and improving the use of AI for European consumers (2020/2216(INI))
